In this Writ Petition, the Petitioner has challenged the Impugned Order dated 03.02.2025 for the Tax Period 2017-2018.

events.quote: There are indications in the Impugned Order dated 03.02.2025 that the Petitioner’s returns were scrutinized under Section 61 and Form ASMT-10 was issued on 28.06.2023, pursuant to which the above mentioned Intimation and the Show Cause Notice were issued.
The Petitioner was earlier issued with an Intimation in Form GST DRC-01A dated 20.09.2023 for the Tax Period 2017-2018

to which, the Petitioner had replied on 29.10.2023 stating that the proposal in the said Intimation in Form GST DRC-01A dated 20.09.2023 was time barred in terms of limitation under Section 73 of the respective GST Enactments.
a Show Cause Notice in Form GST DRC-01 dated 06.12.2023 was issued to the Petitioner.
The Petitioner replied to the Show Cause Notice by a reply dated 04.01.2024.
Pursuant to which, the Impugned Order has been passed under Section 74 of the respective GST Enactments on 03.02.2025.

document_contents.quote: Sir, I have already given detailed reply on 25.07.2023.
Hence, the proposed assessment is time barred and not called for as per the limitation period.
By the Impugned Order, a sum of Rs.11,84,332/- has been confirmed as tax due from the Petitioner together with interest and penalty.

defects_argued.quote: In view of the above, it cannot be said that the proceedings were time barred either under Section 73 or under Section 74 of the respective GST Enactments.
Thus suppression of fact is at large.

outcome.quote: Therefore, this Writ Petition is liable to be dismissed and it is accordingly dismissed.
